findings.title: Hardcoded JWT secret key
findings.rationale: The JWT secret is hardcoded as a string literal 'super-secret-key-123' which will be committed to version control and expose the application to token forgery attacks.

findings.title: Unhandled None return from parse_record()
findings.rationale: parse_record() can return None for malformed input (see its docstring), but the caller on line 22 calls .get() on the result without a null check, causing AttributeError at runtime.
